title: The Shadow with a Very Long Scarf
synopsis: Wendy visits Willow Bend, sees the Story House and lantern, and the friends notice their shadows looking different as the day passes.
continuity_state: Before: Wendy knows Far Meadow but has not visited Story House or Village Green; Clover Nook exists. After: Wendy has visited Village Green and seen the tilted lantern; Amy draws a long shadow by Bell Hill bench; Wendy suggests a ribbon picnic.

related_resources.reason: The adult encourages noticing a change rather than delivering a lengthy explanation; general open-question guidance provides the editorial context.
Shadow length changes with the light angle as the sun moves across the sky. UCAR explains the physical relationship; the fictional scene is invented.
